items: Food: buy cupcakes no more than a day ahead, one per student or one per team, plus a few spares
Food: bring frosting to room temperature; cold frosting is hard to spread
Portion decorations into a cup or plate per team
Decide whether students eat, take home or display their cupcakes

items.text: Premade cupcakes; frosting and decorations of your choice; spreading tools, plates and wipes.
If food isn’t possible: paper liners on a paper-cup base, cotton balls or tissue paper for frosting, and pom-poms, stickers or markers to decorate.

items.title: Share ideas
items.text: Each student names or sketches one decorating idea.

items.title: Plan and roles
items.text: The team agrees one design that uses part of each idea, and picks roles: Leader, Supply Manager, Timekeeper, Clean-Up Crew. In smaller teams, students take more than one role.

items.title: Decorate together
items.text: Hand out decorations once you’ve seen the team’s plan. Food: everyone washes hands. Teams decorate to their plan.

items.title: Clean up
items.text: Teams bin their plates and wipe their tables.
